channels.name: Discord

channels.name: TikTok
channels.note: Receiving real mentions is proven. Posting needs access not yet granted.

chains.name: Solana
chains.note: Executor built and the plan simulates byte-identical to the frozen report. No signature has been produced yet: the launch key is not on the host.

chains.name: Solana
chains.note: Verified 2026-09-11: the platform cannot bind an 80/20 split — no API field, fees accrue to one wallet, and we sign a payment rather than the launch.

chains.name: Robinhood Chain
chains.note: Split contract compiled and reviewed locally. Not deployed, and the EVM wallet holds no funds.

chains.name: BNB Chain
chains.note: Adapter written against the deployed contract; createToken confirmed on chain. The createArg encoding is published nowhere, so nothing is signed.

roadmap.title: Sign the first launch
items: The launch plan already simulates: 1,115-byte transaction, fits the packet, 332k compute units
Build the signer — the adapter carrying the verified 80/20 native split never loads a key, by design
Put the launch keypair on the host and fund it
Flip one route from unavailable to available, with the evidence attached

roadmap.title: Every channel answering
items: Discord answers mentions today — the only worker running
X needs a paid API plan: the mentions endpoint answers 402
Instagram and TikTok access, and a decision on Reddit

roadmap.title: More chains
items: Robinhood Chain through Pons, after the split contract is deployed and reviewed
Route engine picks the cheapest compatible chain per request

roadmap.title: Creator payouts
items: Wallet binding per author, one address per channel identity
Claim flow for the creator share
Public directory of every coin launched through the bot
